title: Four hours of missing time and Crohn's disease healed
summary: Chris Bledsoe tells of Four hours of missing time and Crohn's disease healed, about 2007 (January) at Riverbank, North Carolina, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: 4 hours later, I come walking back to the river where they were and my son was missing.

plain: Chris Bledsoe, a man from North Carolina, says that in January 2007, by a river there, he lost four hours he cannot account for and walked back to find his son missing. He says that after that night his Crohn's disease, a serious gut illness, was healed, which would mean whatever he met could cure people.
